scope: Public prototype development roadmap; no automation, publication, deployment or paid service is authorized by this file.

items.benefit: Guests can keep takeaways, export voluntary suggestions, connect a scoped companion and make one shared garden contribution.
verification: node scripts/verify-browser.mjs against the chosen local server

items.benefit: Pairing stays understandable and bounded under failed connections, stale invitations, slow requests and exhausted limits.
items.preconditions: Preserve observe/wave default and no conversation access; do not widen the capability vocabulary.

items.benefit: A first visitor can find the garden and understand which plots are free without reading a long explanation.
items.preconditions: Original small cues using current materials; no paid assets, engine changes or additional tracking. Preserve routes and current art direction.

items.benefit: Keep the cute houses and authored forest while improving the visible path, deck and character readability.
items.preconditions: One bounded art pass using existing licensed assets only: prioritize angular outer path/ground joins, repeated grass, dark garden/character and flat deck material. Preserve composition, collision route. No new downloads/accounts, paid assets in public, engine migration, publication or unrelated UI. Capture matched before/after views. Do not modify private rig/animation in this item.
verification: before/after desktop and phone captures with a clear visual decision
full keyboard/touch routes, workshop draft journey and no browser errors

items.benefit: Visitors have an immediate local escape from unwanted text without an opaque bad-actor scoring system.
items.preconditions: Implement per-session personal text mute and a local report draft/export. No permanent bans, identity inference, remote reporting or silent capture. Explicitly distinguish text mute from voice behavior.
verification: muting affects only the muting visitor
report exports only selected permitted evidence

items.benefit: Accepted creations survive return visits with clear ownership, deletion and restore semantics.
items.reason: Choose durable identity/ownership and shared acceptance rules before migrating temporary guest contributions into persistent public content. Prepare a concrete design and local fixture; do not infer consent to persist existing sessions.

items.benefit: Members can join from different devices and networks with reliable hosting and optional live AI.
items.reason: Explicit publication/provider/budget approval, admission/moderation, rights and data-processing choices required. Existing publication work remains separate.

note: Public roadmap only. Private cycle history, leases, automation status and evidence are not included.
